verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers explicitly documents native Bindings for connecting to databases, storage, and APIs with minimal code (cloudflare-docs-10), backed by concrete examples like D1 database creation via Wrangler (cloudflare-docs-38), serverless SQL/KV/global database acceleration queried directly from Workers with no connection management (cloudflare-docs-4), and community confirmation of easy DX with KV and D1 (cloudflare-comm-3, cloudflare-comm-11). missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarking of boilerplate reduction versus hand-wired SDKs, and some community skepticism about vendor lock-in with bindings (cloudflare-comm-10) tempers the otherwise strong first-party documentation.
